idea: I run a small plumbing business, just me and four techs. I want to build an app that works like a CRM for us -- tracks our customers and jobs, but really the big thing I need is help getting invoices paid faster. Half my customers pay 30 to 60 days late and I'm constantly chasing people down for checks. Doesn't need to be fancy, just something so we stop losing track of who still owes us money.
customer: The plumbing business owner, who already does the scheduling and books and is the one chasing late payers, plus the four techs who need to see which jobs are billed and to whom.
pieces: not decomposed -- no independent Slicer has acted on this idea. See foundry/README.md, 'Slicer honesty correction.'
